description: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and ACC (%). The x-axis is labeled “Co-occurrence Number” and uses a logarithmic scale, ranging from 1 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled “ACC (%)” and uses a linear scale, ranging from 60 to 80, with tick labels at 60, 65, 70, 75, and 80. There are six lines shown. The black line, labeled “Base”, begins at approximately (1, 63%) and ends at approximately (1000, 72%), showing a steady increase. The red triangle line, labeled “FT”, begins at approximately (1, 68%) and ends at approximately (1000, 73%), also showing a steady increase. The blue triangle line, labeled “IKE”, begins at approximately (1, 65%) and ends at approximately (1000, 70%), with a steady increase. The purple line, labeled “MEND”, begins at approximately (1, 70%) and ends at approximately (1000, 77%), showing a steady increase. The pink line, labeled “MEMIT”, begins at approximately (1, 71%) and ends at approximately (1000, 78%), with a steady increase. Finally, the green square line, labeled “ROME”, begins at approximately (1, 73%) and ends at approximately (1000, 80%), showing a steady increase.
